notes: Section 6, 1929 edition (Sunset / Parkside east end, Forest Hill, Laguna Honda, Sutro Forest, Twin Peaks, Golden Gate Park east end, Haight; joins Sec. 5 above, 3 right, 7 below, 12 left as scanned), 5400x4117. 1-bit photocopy, the sheet lies on its side (title reads top to bottom). Frame on all four sides: thick bar (~15 px), 2-5 px of white, thin inner rule (3-5 px, the innermost rule), with a thick + thin quarter arc in every corner; each thin arc joins its two side rules through a short connector (a 5-10 px joggle). Rule 1: the outline lies on the first or second px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, points every <=150 px along the sides and <=30 px along the arcs, so the bowed rules are followed. Rule 2: the outline follows the thin arc's inner edge 1-2 px inside it and steps round each connector on its map side, so arcs, connectors and everything beyond them are outside. Page turned ~0.8 deg and bowed: thin rule's inner face top y 359 (x 250) -> 324 (x 5095), bottom 3951 -> 3941 (3939 at mid), left x 31 (y 580) -> 71 (y 3725), right 5323 -> 5332. Arc radii TL ~209, TR ~217, BR ~203, BL ~206. Connector steps at TL y 577 / x 247, TR x 5097 / y 551, BR y 3727 / x 5111, BL x 291 / y 3729. Top bar missing in the copy at x ~303-425; the thin rule is there and the outline keeps to it. Bottom rule broken (white blotch) at x ~3812-3870: the outline keeps the line of the rule either side. Kind (b), map ink that truly touches the frame and is left under the outline (this sheet is hatched and built up to the frame on three sides, so 327 of 347 stretches hold some ink): the solid block at the top-left corner is fused to the left rule and the TL arc (y ~550-775; the TL-left connector is hidden in it and the step there is placed from the rule's start at y 571); solid commercial strips fused to the top rule at x ~3920-4220 and to the bottom rule at x ~4630-4680; block lines fused along the top rule at x ~1170-1320, 1960-2070, 2670-2820 and elsewhere; hatch lines and street lines run into the left rule nearly all the way down, into the TL / BL arcs, and into the top and bottom rules; a hatch line starts on the left rule right at the BL-left connector (y ~3725-3736) and one at the TL-top junction (x ~240-250). The right side (Golden Gate Park) is clean but for street-line ends. 'Join Sec.' lettering prints outside the frame. remove[0]: the rotated CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP / PREPARED BY / CITY PLANNING COMMISSION / 1929 / R.S. WOODWARD title, LEGEND with its six swatches and labels and ditto marks, and the scale bar with 0 / 1000 and its SCALE lettering (lower right, no ruled box, on open paper; ink x 4669-5316, y 3106-3774): a 20-point stepped outline 3-6 px outside the ink; its top edge (y 3104) runs in the 3 px of paper between the street line above (bottom y 3100-3102) and the swatches (top y 3106-3108), then steps down right of the swatches; a bulge takes SCALE. No ink under it. remove[1]: the compass rose with its long arrow (tail feather x 2511-2565, y 2677-2700; head with its crescent, tip ~3329,2725) and the magnetic needle with its flag (tip ~3300,2835). THE WHOLE COMPASS IS PRINTED OVER MAP INK: it stands in the diagonally hatched first-residential area south of Laguna Honda (hatch lines ~4-5 px thick every ~25 px, at ~31 deg), which run through the rose, the shafts, the feather and both heads; dotted map lines also cross the tail (x ~2545-2640) and pass the rose above and below. So the outline is kept tight (36 points, more than the usual 12): a hull 5-6 px outside the eight points of the rose (N tip ~2929,2573; S ~2919,2844; NE ~3007,2632; SE ~3001,2791; SW ~2838,2784; NW ~2846,2624), and strips 2-5 px outside the ink of the tail, the arrow and the needle; the hatching between and across them is removed with the compass, and the outline crosses hatch lines all the way round (remove-outline ink ~560). remove[2]: the SECTION 6 badge (ring centre 5202.5,3821.4, outer radius 58.1), an octagon 5.5 px outside the ring, on open paper between the title and the BR arc. Not removed: street names, block numbers, park names. Doubt: a few short strokes just outside the rose's lower right (~2992,2809-2816) read as part of a dotted map line and are left as map.
drawn_by: Claude (training-label agent LD, issue #71), 2026-11-21: from the scan and inputs/frame-labels/README.md only (no model output, no test label looked at). Sides: the thin rule's outer face (beside the white gap to the bar) measured on every px and fitted locally (+-60 px), its inner face taken as that plus the local rule width (a low percentile of the run widths, since fused map ink only widens a run); the outline placed 1-2.5 px inside the inner face by a per-px path search that prefers 2 px and moves only to get off ink. Corner arcs: rays through a fitted centre for the circular part, the tails followed px by px to the connectors; connector steps read from pixel dumps. Remove polygons from full-resolution crops (hatch lines greyed out to see the rose) and measured ink boxes. Checked: every vertex close up, all eight connectors at 6x, the four arcs at 3x, px-by-px statistics of the outline against the rule, margins of each remove polygon against the ink pieces, and the ranked ink stretches.
